responsibility: This implementation module provides a debugger-attachment spin mechanism for GNU Modula-2 programs. It maintains a boolean gate, prints attach and breakpoint instructions using libc, waits in one-second sleep cycles until finishSpin clears the gate, offers connectSpin as a deliberate breakpoint target, and can write a .gdbinit helper file using FIO, SFIO, and StringConvert. Its responsibility is runtime debugging coordination rather than general exception or logging support.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the runtime implementation for the gdbif pair: it maintains the mustWait gate, sleeps and prints gdb attach/break commands, defines the breakpoint stub, and can write a .gdbinit helper file, whereas gdbif.def only declares those entry points.
